prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single objectively “best” HVAC company for every Houston homeowner — but two firms consistently highly rated locally are John Moore Services and ARS/Rescue Rooter. If you want a short list tailored to your neighborhood I can pull top-rated techs for your ZIP code.

How to pick the best company for your situation
- Check recent reviews (Google, Yelp, Angi) and Better Business Bureau rating.
- Verify Texas HVAC license (TACLA) and liability insurance on the TDLR website.
- Look for NATE-certified technicians or manufacturer training for your AC brand.
- Ask about diagnostic fees, flat-rate vs. time & materials pricing, parts warranty, and labor warranty.
- Confirm 24/7 emergency availability if you need quick repairs and how they handle after-hours fees.
- Request a written estimate and get a second opinion for major repairs or replacement.
- Prefer companies that offer maintenance plans if you want ongoing care.

If you give your ZIP code or neighborhood, I can list the top-rated HVAC repair companies near you and the pros/cons of each.
